hooks.command: f=$(python -c 'import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *scripts/*.ps1) pat=$(printf '[^ -~\t\r]'); grep -qE "$pat" "$f" 2>/dev/null && echo "WARNING: non-ASCII byte(s) in $f -- PowerShell 5.1 reads .ps1 as ANSI without a BOM; UTF-8 em-dashes/smart quotes will mojibake and break the parser (CLAUDE.md: ASCII-only script bodies)." ;; esac; true
hooks.description: Warn on non-ASCII bytes in edited .ps1 scripts (CLAUDE.md ASCII-only gotcha)

hooks.command: test -f scripts/check_doc_drift.py && { out=$(python scripts/check_doc_drift.py docs/adr/*.md CONTEXT.md 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$out" ] && printf 'DOC DRIFT WARNING (non-blocking):\n%s\n' "$out"; }; true
hooks.description: Warn (non-blocking) on stale doc/ADR file citations before commit; now live via scripts/check_doc_drift.py (issue #1142, merged in PR #1144)
